_doc: Arena 10 (retail world 41: a butcher's kitchen) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena7/kit.json (kind cap = lies over another block's top: y = 0 is that top). Its blood drain and butcher's axes are in the arena 9 kit; pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.

pieces.name: brick_slab
pieces.label: Losa de ladrillos
pieces.note: lies over a wooden post (984, 985): y = 0 is the post's top; three by three soft square bricks; the kitchen floor

pieces.name: wood_post
pieces.label: Poste de madera
pieces.note: a cell-wide block of old timber under the floor; the brick slab (2736) caps it; stack them for taller drops

pieces.name: wood_post_alt
pieces.label: Poste de madera (otro corte)
pieces.note: the same post, its timbers cut another way

pieces.name: blood_river
pieces.label: Río de sangre
pieces.note: a cell of glossy blood edge to edge; a run of them is the river, a step below the floor

pieces.name: blood_gutter
pieces.label: Canaleta de sangre
pieces.note: lies on a floor slab: blood between two low pale curbs, along x, edge to edge so gutters chain

pieces.name: blood_gutter_corner
pieces.label: Canaleta de sangre (esquina)
pieces.note: the gutter turning from +x to +z at the cell's centre

pieces.name: blood_stream
pieces.label: Chorro de sangre
pieces.note: y = 0 is the floor rim a gutter pours over, x = 0 its face; falls about 1.3 m into a splash

pieces.name: blood_fall
pieces.label: Cascada de sangre
pieces.note: a river cell pouring over its +x side, about 5.5 m down the island's edge; turn it to face the drop
